summary.key_theme: Ouster 成功打入 John Deere 旗下 GUSS Automation 的自動化果園機隊供應鏈，強化了其在物理 AI 與 LiDAR 市場的領導地位。

bullish.title: Ouster Announces Its Rev8 OS0 Native Color Digital Lidar Sensors Will Be Integrated Into Deere Subsidiary Guss Automation's Autonomous Orchard Machine Fleet

bullish.title: How Ouster Is Helping Deere Implement Physical AI
bullish.reason: 深入分析 Ouster 如何透過 LiDAR 技術協助 John Deere 實現物理 AI，強化了市場對該公司作為自動化基礎設施關鍵供應商的信心。

bullish.title: Is Ouster (OUST) Undervalued As John Deere's GUSS Picks Its Lidar For Orchard Robots?
bullish.reason: 該報導結合了最新的合作利多與估值分析，指出市場可能低估了 Ouster 在農業機器人領域的長期成長價值。

bullish.title: Brokers Suggest Investing in Ouster (OUST): Read This Before Placing a Bet

bearish.title: Is Ouster (OUST) Stock Too Expensive After A Very Large 3 Year Run?
